feed.subtitle: Mehmet Yigit Turali is a Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at UCLA, advised by Prof. Vwani P. Roychowdhury, working on LLM agents with structured memory (Generative Semantic Workspaces), deep-research agents (PANINI-DR), continual learning (PANINI, ICML 2026), and machine learning for healthcare (NeurIPS 2026).
